```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
pacman::p_load(cmdstanr, tidyverse,posterior, bayesplot, tidybayes,
               brms, patchwork, cowplot,ggpubr,flextable)


invisible(lapply(
  list.files(here::here("Experimental analysis", "Scripts"), full.names = TRUE),
  function(f) source(f, echo = FALSE, print.eval = FALSE)
))

```
## Extracting the data:

```{r, warning=F, message=F}
df = load_data()
```   

## plotting the behavioral data:
```{r, fig.height=6,fig.width=8, message=F,warning=F}
plot_beh_data(df %>% filter(Trialtype == "Main"),NULL,F)
```


## fit the standard model with meta-uncertainty and meta-bias
```{r}
model1 = cmdstanr::cmdstan_model(here::here("Stanmodels","MCMC","Emperical dataanalysis","Single Subject","Model1_ex.stan"))

dd = df %>% 
  mutate(subject = as.numeric(as.factor(subject))) %>% 
  filter(Trialtype == "Main", scale == "conf") %>% drop_na()

dd_by_subj <- split(dd, dd$subject)

fits <- lapply(dd_by_subj, function(d) {
  fit_model_ss(d, model1, 500)
})
```


```{r}
models = list.files(here::here("Experimental analysis","MCMC","saved models"), full.names = T)

fits = list()
for(model in models[1:8]){
  fit = readRDS(model)
  fits[[str_remove(str_remove(str_split(model, "/")[[1]][8],".rds"),"fit_")]] = fit  
}

```


```{r, fig.width=8,fig.height=6}
dia(fits, dd)
```


```{r}
df <- read_csv(here::here("Data","Pilots","Kelly_2025_17_12","RDM_reportz_sub3_1.csv")) %>%
  mutate(resp = ifelse(resp == "down",0,1),
         interval = as.numeric(interval),
       stim = ifelse(`dots direction` == 270, -coherence,coherence)) %>%
  mutate(D = ifelse(`dots direction` == 270, -1, 1)) %>% 
  mutate(ACC = ifelse(resp == 1 & stim > 0, 1,
                      ifelse(resp == 0 & stim < 0, 1,0))) %>%
  filter(Trialtype == "Main") %>%
  filter(SR_conf != "None") %>%
  filter(scale == "conf") %>%
  mutate(SR_conf = as.numeric(SR_conf)) %>%
  rename(X = stim, RT = RTdec, Correct = cor, Y = resp) %>%
  filter(RT < 2.5) %>% 
  mutate(Confidence = (SR_conf+1)/2)
```

```{r}
df <- read_csv(here::here("Data","Pilots","Jesper_2025_17_12","RDM_reportz_sub5.csv")) %>%
  mutate(resp = ifelse(resp == "down",0,1),
         interval = as.numeric(interval),
       stim = ifelse(`dots direction` == 270, -coherence,coherence)) %>%
    mutate(D = ifelse(`dots direction` == 270, -1, 1)) %>% 
  mutate(ACC = ifelse(resp == 1 & stim > 0, 1,
                      ifelse(resp == 0 & stim < 0, 1,0))) %>%
  filter(Trialtype == "Main") %>%
  filter(SR_conf != "None") %>%
    # filter(scale == "conf") %>%
  mutate(SR_conf = as.numeric(SR_conf)) %>%
  rename(X = stim, RT = RTdec, Correct = cor, Y = resp) %>%
  mutate(Confidence = (SR_conf+1)/2)


evi = fit_jesper$summary("evidence")
ehat = fit_jesper$summary("ehat")



data.frame(evidence = evi$mean, ehat = ehat$mean, conf = df$Confidence, correct = as.factor(df$ACC)) %>% 
    mutate(conf = as.factor(cut(conf,5))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = evidence, y = ehat, fill = interaction(correct,conf)),col = correct)+geom_point(shape = 21, size = 3)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_10)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("red","green"))
  facet_wrap(~correct)

data.frame(evidence = evi$mean, ehat = ehat$mean, conf = df$Confidence, correct = as.factor(df$ACC)) %>% 
  mutate(dif = evidence-ehat) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = dif, y = conf, col = correct))+geom_point()
  facet_wrap(~correct)


```

```{r}
df1 <- read_csv(here::here("Data","Pilots","Siebe_2025_17_12","RDM_reportz_sub6.csv")) %>%
  mutate(resp = ifelse(resp == "down",0,1),
         interval = as.numeric(interval),
       stim = ifelse(`dots direction` == 270, -coherence,coherence)) %>%
  mutate(ACC = ifelse(resp == 1 & stim > 0, 1,
                      ifelse(resp == 0 & stim < 0, 1,0))) %>%
    mutate(D = ifelse(`dots direction` == 270, -1, 1)) %>% 
  filter(Trialtype == "Main") %>%
  filter(SR_conf != "None") %>%
    # filter(scale == "conf") %>%
  mutate(SR_conf = as.numeric(SR_conf)) %>%
  rename(X = stim, RT = RTdec, Correct = cor, Y = resp) %>%
  mutate(Confidence = (SR_conf+1)/2)  %>% 
  filter(RT < 2.5) %>% 
  dplyr::select(Y,RT,D,Confidence,coherence,RTrating,X) %>% 
  mutate(Subject = 4) %>% 
  drop_na()


dd = rbind(df4,df2,df3)


# mod = cmdstanr::cmdstan_model(here::here("Derivations","Hierarchical","full.stan")) This is the fit version atm

# mod = cmdstanr::cmdstan_model(here::here("Derivations","Hierarchical","nort_gamma.stan"))
mod = cmdstanr::cmdstan_model(here::here("Derivations","Hierarchical","gamma_full.stan"))


datastan = list(a = dd$Y,
                D = dd$D,
                C = dd$Confidence,
                N = nrow(dd),
                RT = dd$RT,
                minRT = dd %>% group_by(Subject) %>% summarise(minRT = min(RT))%>% .$minRT,
                X = dd$coherence,
                S = length(unique(dd$Subject)),
                S_id = dd$Subject)


fit_gamma = mod$sample(data = datastan,
                 iter_warmup = 1000,
                 refresh = 100,
                 adapt_delta = 0.99,
                 max_treedepth = 12,
                 iter_sampling = 1000,
           parallel_chains = 4)

fit_gamma$save_object(here::here("Savedmodels","removed_models","fit1_hier_mec_all_gamma_15tree.rds"))


parameters = c("gm","tau_u")
sum = fit$summary(c(parameters))

plot = mcmc_pairs(fit$draws(c(parameters)),np = nuts_params(fit))
plot2 = mcmc_trace(fit$draws(c(parameters)),np = nuts_params(fit))
```

## meta-d

```{r}
library(statConfR)


data = df4 %>% mutate(conf_bin = cut(Confidence,4),
                      stimulus  = as.factor(D),
                      participant = 1,
                      rating = as.numeric(as.factor(conf_bin)),
                      correct = ifelse(Y == 0 & D == -1,1,ifelse(Y == 1 & D== 1,1,0))) %>% drop_na()



q = fitMetaDprime(data)

q$Ratio

```
